title: Joni P NDE 4552
content: I was looking down at the hospital bed where I was lying. I thought I was on some steep stairs, but realized later that was not the case. I was evidently hovering about the ceiling. The next thing I knew I was standing by some hedges that I had come through. A young girl there told me she was my sister and she did look very much like my oldest sister who was eight years older than I was. She said I was to stay there with her and I asked her if this was school. She said it was something like a school, which made me happy, as I wanted to go to school like my three older sisters. She took my hand and led me down a path into a very beautiful place. Everything was perfect, rolling hills, green grass and a stream running nearby. She said she was not sure if I were able to stay, she would have to leave me for a while to find out. I was not allowed past a certain place. On the other side, it looked like there were crystal buildings which I thought must be the school. She led me to a large tree with outspread branches. She sat me on one of the branches and left. There were a few other children in the tree and some babies on the ground. There was not a sound from any of them. I was happy sitting in the tree looking around and soon my friend returned. She said I could not stay and I would have to return. I was not happy about it, but knew it wasn't up to me. I really hated to leave.

tunnel.passage_other_detail: Thought I was on some steep stairs, but realized later that was not the case.

arrival.other_being_detail: A young girl said she was the experiencer's sister and resembled the experiencer's oldest sister.

environment.environment_other_detail: Very beautiful place: rolling hills, green grass, nearby stream; crystal buildings on the other side of a certain boundary; large tree with outspread branches.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Transitional sensation of 'steep stairs' before arriving by hedges and entering the beautiful place.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE (hovering near ceiling) then transition described as 'steep stairs', then arrival by hedges into a beautiful environment; boundary encountered; told to return.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: Presence of silent children in a large tree and babies on the ground; experiencer seated on a branch while the 'sister' left to find out if she could stay; 'crystal buildings' beyond a restricted point that seemed like a school.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I was looking down at the hospital bed where I was lying.” “I was evidently hovering about the ceiling.” “She said it was something like a school.” “Everything was perfect, rolling hills, green grass and a stream running nearby.” “I was not allowed past a certain place.” “She said I could not stay and I would have to return.” “I really hated to leave.”
